Commentary of King Fahd Complex (al-Tafsir al-Muyassar) on surah 111, verse 1:

**Naming of the Surah**

• It is called al-Masad (the Palm Fiber), because of its mention in it, and it is: a rope twisted from palm fiber.

**Some of the Objectives of the Surah**

• Rebuking Abu Lahab for harming the Prophet ﷺ, and warning him of punishment for that; and warning his wife for supporting her husband and harboring hatred toward the Prophet ﷺ. This is to console the Prophet ﷺ over what he encounters from his people of opposition and harm, and to clarify that wealth a person has acquired does not avail him when he disobeys the command of Allah and the command of His Messenger ﷺ.

[The Tafsir]

﴿Perish the hands of Abu Lahab, and he has perished﴾ — and Abu Lahab, through his harming of the Messenger of Allah Muhammad ﷺ, has wretched himself; and the perdition of Abu Lahab has indeed been realized.
His wealth and his children did not avail him. They will not ward off from him anything of God's punishment when it descends upon him.
He will enter the Fire of Hell, the blazing Fire, along with his wife, who used to carry thorns, and she will throw them in the path of the Prophet (ﷺ) to harm him.
He will enter the Fire of Hell, the blazing Fire, along with his wife, who used to carry thorns, and she will throw them in the path of the Prophet (ﷺ) to harm him.
In her neck is a rope of tightly twisted palm fiber, rough and strong, by which she will be hoisted up into the Fire of Hell, and then thrown down to its depths.
